purpose: One-year repeating 365-anchor story calendar for Isla. Every calendar date has a predetermined daily-life anchor generated from coherent monthly arcs, weekly rhythms, and recurring sub-character threads. Major events layer on top; they do not replace the daily canon.

rules.leap_year_policy: 02-29 reuses 02-28 daily anchor unless explicitly added later

Mum.allowed_surface: phone message, missed call, calendar note

Maya.allowed_surface: text message or shared photo notification

Lena.allowed_surface: library reminder, reservation email, due-date slip

Theo.allowed_surface: doorstep note, dog-walk message, local reminder

Isla.allowed_surface: calendar note, notebook line, phone reminder

year_arc.title: Isla builds a steadier year one small commitment at a time.
year_arc.rule: Every day has a concrete life reason before the puzzle appears. The puzzle responds to the day; it is never the whole story.

quarter_arcs.theme: move outside, reconnect, prepare for travel
turn notes into useful output and keep promises
gather ideas, reset the room, close the year properly

Monday.story_move: Isla decides what gets done before the week starts making decisions for her.

Tuesday.story_move: A small errand changes the route and gives the puzzle a narrow window.

Wednesday.story_move: Isla keeps one useful thought instead of collecting another half-finished idea.

Thursday.story_move: A work message tests whether Isla can answer properly without giving away the whole day.

Friday.story_move: Isla chooses a proper reply instead of leaving the message hanging.

Saturday.story_move: The day starts with movement, so the puzzle has to fit around real life rather than replace it.

Sunday.story_move: Isla resets one visible thing so Monday starts with less friction.

02.daily_focus: returning borrowed things and closing small loops

03.name: March appointment pressure
03.daily_focus: leaving on time and not letting appointments eat the day

04.name: April outdoor reset
04.daily_focus: starting outside before screens take over

05.name: May family and bank-holiday texture
05.daily_focus: keeping personal time even when plans move around

06.daily_focus: packing, leaving, and using unfamiliar tables well

07.name: July creative print review
07.daily_focus: turning scattered notes into something usable

08.name: August errands and fulfilment
08.daily_focus: sending things, collecting things, and making routes count

09.name: September friendship and follow-through
09.daily_focus: replying, remembering, and not letting people become background tasks

10.name: October library ideas
10.daily_focus: using the library as a place where ideas get sorted

11.name: November room reset
11.daily_focus: making the room less noisy before the day begins

12.name: December family and year close
12.daily_focus: answering properly and closing the year without rushing

events.title: Mum birthday
events.day_before_story: Isla needs to choose a card, send a message properly, or pick up something small before tomorrow.
events.day_of_story: Isla makes room for a family call or birthday message without letting the day become only a task list.
events.day_after_story: Isla carries the feeling of having replied properly into a calmer day.

events.title: Library books due
events.day_before_story: Isla gathers the books and decides whether to return them today or make time tomorrow.
events.day_of_story: The library errand shapes the day and gives the puzzle a reading-room stop.
events.day_after_story: The returned books leave space for the next small habit.

events.title: Dentist check-up
events.day_before_story: Isla prepares to leave earlier than usual and keeps the puzzle moment short.
events.day_of_story: The appointment gives the strip a real deadline and changes where the puzzle fits.
events.day_after_story: The day after the appointment can feel lighter or slightly disrupted.

events.title: Early walk morning
events.day_before_story: Isla sets out shoes, coat, keys, or a bag so the morning walk actually happens.
events.day_of_story: The walk changes the day before the puzzle starts, giving the story outdoor movement.
events.day_after_story: The previous walk becomes proof that starting outside helped.

events.title: Family bank holiday plan
events.day_before_story: Isla needs to decide what to take and whether to keep the morning free.
events.day_of_story: The family plan makes the day non-work and shifts the puzzle into a small private window.
events.day_after_story: The story can pick up the after-feeling of having stepped away from routine.

events.title: Night away
events.day_before_story: Isla packs a small overnight bag, charger, notebook, and ticket, changing the next day setup.
events.day_of_story: The story can happen in a hotel room, station, or unfamiliar table instead of a normal routine.
events.day_after_story: Checkout, return travel, or a hotel-room aftermath can shape the next strip.

events.title: Print notes review
events.day_before_story: Isla collects notebook pages and decides what is worth keeping.
events.day_of_story: The creative review puts books, notes, and readable wall text naturally into the panels.
events.day_after_story: The chosen note can become a small phrase on a poster or book spine later.

events.title: Post office errand
events.day_before_story: Isla puts envelopes or a parcel near the bag so tomorrow has a reason to move.
events.day_of_story: The post-office errand dictates the route and gives the puzzle a queue or counter-side stop.
events.day_after_story: The sent parcel leaves a visible empty space on the table.

events.title: Friend birthday
events.day_before_story: Isla notices the reminder and chooses not to leave the message until the last second.
events.day_of_story: The birthday message creates a more social day without needing another visible person.
events.day_after_story: The reply or photo sent back can influence the next morning.

events.title: Library idea day
events.day_before_story: Isla gathers a notebook and book list before going to the library.
events.day_of_story: The library setting becomes the real reason for the day flow, not a random location swap.
events.day_after_story: A kept idea can carry into the next day's poster or book-title texture.

events.title: Room reset
events.day_before_story: Isla notices the room has become part of the problem and prepares to reset it.
events.day_of_story: Bedroom or home reset gives the strip a practical, visual non-work shape.
events.day_after_story: The tidier room makes tomorrow's first choice easier.

events.title: Family call
events.day_before_story: Isla makes space to call properly instead of sending a rushed reply.
events.day_of_story: The family call changes the evening rhythm and gives the puzzle a boundary.
events.day_after_story: The next day can carry the relief of having made time.
